design_philosophy: Enterprise-trustworthy, highly polished, massive typography with generous whitespace. Feels like real, powerful software running in the background. Calm, snappy motion. NO bouncing, NO particle backgrounds, NO 'AI slop' imagery. Use clean NDA pills for logos and precise, technical label pairing.

primary.description: Electric Blue for primary actions, CTA buttons, and technical highlights.

accent.description: Mint. Use very sparingly for 'Success', 'ROAS', or 'Active' indicators.

scales.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[88px] font-medium tracking-[-0.02em] leading-[1.05]
scales.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight
scales.mono_label: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-tertiary

spacing_and_layout.generous_whitespace: Always favor empty space over cramming. Use pt-32 or pt-40 for major section transitions.

surface_and_borders.cards: bg-white border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
surface_and_borders.glass_header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border z-50 sticky top-0
surface_and_borders.nda_pill: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-background-secondary text-xs font-mono text-text-secondary

motion_and_animations.hero_loop_choreography: Simulate a live UI. Steps: 1. Fetching UGC (loading bar). 2. Generating copy (typing effect in a small mono block). 3. Uploading to Meta (progress spinner). 4. Success state with +45% ROAS in Mint color. Loop seamlessly every 8 seconds.

component_blueprints.hero_dashboard_mockup: A bento-style floating UI window next to the massive H1. Give it a thin border border-border, shadow-2xl, rounded-2xl bg-white overflow-hidden. Inside, show a mini dashboard with Geist mono logs and an avatar pill for 'Kai'.
component_blueprints.agent_grid_card: Minimalist card. Top: Agent Name (Geist) + Role (JetBrains Mono). Middle: 1px border divider. Bottom: 2-3 capabilities listed as crisp rows with Lucide icons (Check, ArrowRight).
component_blueprints.industries_cards: Hover-reveal or large image cards for E-com / Healthcare / Coming Next. Overlays must be black/40 to ensure contrast. Typography on cards: white Geist.
component_blueprints.stats_counter: Massive typography (text-7xl) for stats (e.g. 60%, 24/7). Pair with tiny uppercase JetBrains Mono description.
component_blueprints.contact_form: Minimalist form using shadcn components. Floating labels or clean inputs with 1px borders. Focus ring should be Electric Blue.
component_blueprints.nda_logo_bar: A horizontal row of pills saying 'BRAND UNDER NDA', 'FINTECH CLIENT', 'DTC SKINCARE', styled as subtle bordered pills. Use react-fast-marquee for slow, calm movement.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these exact images for the vertical pages and placeholders. NO placeholder domains like via.placeholder.com.

images.description: Minimalist skincare bottles. Use on E-commerce vertical page.
Minimalist sneaker. Use on E-commerce page for varied content.
Contemporary aesthetic clinic interior. Use on Healthcare vertical page.

media.avatar_placeholder: Do not use a stock photo. Generate an initial-based avatar via CSS: a 48x48 rounded-full div, bg-[#0A0A0A], text-white, flex items-center justify-center font-mono, displaying 'S' or 'F'.

testing.guidelines: All interactive elements and forms MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
